description_long:
Peanut Split turns a group chat into a shared expense room. Paste one link and everyone can open the same room and add what they paid - no account, no install, no app store. The catalog recognises 162 room currencies, and 156 of them convert automatically at the day's indicative rate.

Split evenly, by shares, by percentage or by exact amounts. Import an existing group from Splitwise, or scan a receipt to itemise it. Expenses typed with no signal wait on your phone and go when it comes back, and it installs to the home screen on iOS, Android and desktop as a Progressive Web App.

When it is time to settle up, Split turns the balances into a short payment plan and lets people pay in cash, by bank transfer, or through Peanut. Free to use, with no ads and no paid tier.
